Job Description:
ROLE
PURPOSE
:
Save the Children is a leading independent organization creating lasting change for children in need around the world. With its headquarters in London, UK, SC works in over 120 countries globally, including Nigeria, helping children survive, learn and be protected by improving their education, health, nutrition, protection and economic opportunities, and in times of acute crisis, mobilizing rapid life-saving assistance to help children recover from the effects of war, conflict and natural disasters.
Save the Children International in consortium with Plan International have been selected as implementing partners to implement education and youth empowerment project funded by EU over a 36 months period in the North-West Nigeria across states of Sokoto, Kano and Jigawa. The project is focusing to provide youth, in particular girls in rural underserved and nomadic communities, with access to inclusive gender transformative and conflict sensitive equitable quality education and skill development. The project will support the governments’ efforts to address the challenge of Out of School Children and Youth (OOSCY) to access Accelerated Basic Education Programme (ABEP) in the 3 states. The project will also support the efforts of the Federal and respective State governments to empower youth with green jobs and vocational skills through vocational training as well as address the barriers that girls and women face to access education and livelihood opportunities.
The Education Programme Coordinator will lead the delivery and implementation of the EU funded project while providing technical guidance to the implementing partner(s) on the project. S/he will provide both operational and technical oversight on project management delivery of results of Education component synergy and integration across other thematic areas. S/he will provide operational and technical support to the team under the leadership of the Deputy Consortium Manager to implement all Education activities for the project. Further, the job holder will provide capacity strengthening, monitoring and evaluation and reporting both internally and externally, the development of the Detailed Implementation Plan, participating in stakeholders’ meetings, and contribute to narrative reporting in line with donor requirement. S/he will be responsible for ensuring stakeholders are involved throughout the project management cycle while ensuring collaboration with other consortium members.
Under the operational guidance of the Deputy Consortium Manager and the technical guidance from the Head of Education, the Education Programme Coordinator will ensure that the EU-INTPA project is implemented in a coordinated, harmonized and aligned manner, in line with SCI standards, donor requirements, project agreement and commitments. S/he will ensure that quality reports are submitted in timely manner.
KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY
Project Coordination & Management:
Oversee the coordination and implementation of the EU-INTPA Project in Kano and Jigawa State, Nigeria in line with the design of the project and donor requirements.
Lead the education team on assessments, community mapping and identification of schools/learning centres and ABEP facilitators for the implementation of the ABEP programme in collaboration with stakeholders in line with the project design.
Ensure accurate project documentation, including collection of impact stories, monitoring data, and tracking progress on output indicators and utilize data appropriately to report it in project reports.
Establish, maintain, and strengthen linkages in the planning, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation on the project As well as contribute to assessments (baseline, needs, market).
Guide project team on community entry meetings and project stakeholders’ engagement to ensure buy-in for project and Do No Harm to children in project locations.
Sustain positive working relationships with the implementing partner, government officials at state and LGA level, local communities, and other key stakeholders and strengthen their capacities.
Ensure submission of timely and quality reports (Narrative and Financial) as per the reporting requirements.
Ensure that project is implemented with the highest consideration to security and safe programming standards of Save the Children.
Operational Planning and implementation
In collaboration with the Deputy Consortium Manager, support the development, implementation, monitoring of project detail implementation plan, procurement plan, phased budget, MEAL Plan with documentation and reporting for EU-INTPA Project in Kano and Jigawa States.
Lead the planning for the implementation of the ABEP activities and other education interventions with the project team within SCI’s Education portfolio.
Recommend technical solutions to speed up the implementation and budget performance in line with the project plan and budget.
Work with the Deputy Consortium Manager to ensure integration of other sectors like Youth, Green Jobs and Vocational Training into Education activities.
Maintain high standard of transparency and accountability during programme design and support in expediting implementation while ensuring integrity and timeliness of project duration and meeting programme objectives, compliance with donors & Save the Children policies.
Provide regular operations and implementation updates as it relates to the Education component to the Deputy Consortium Manager on project progress and challenges to allow for timely interventions and corrective actions by the management.
Ensure the timely reviews and adjustments for the project operational and implementation plan and budget as may be required from time to time.
Work to ensure coordination across all other consortium partners in the implementation of the Education activities.
Finance and Budget Management
Support the Deputy Consortium Manager in budget monitoring, suggest necessary revisions and prepare draft reports for corrective actions.
Support the Deputy Consortium Manager in ensuring that the budget variance analysis (BVA) is monitored and reported as per in time and with accurate information.
Programme/Project Narrative and Financial Reporting.
Preparation of timely and high-quality progress and end of project narrative and financial reports which are in accordance with the donor reporting schedule and formats.
Participate in reviewing all programme financial reports ensuring that donor guidelines have been followed and high standard met.
Participate in progress review meetings to address key performance issues from the reports.
The project deadlines met in reporting and keep a track record of reporting (Narrative and Financial).
Safeguarding
Ensure safe programming in the planning, implementation, monitoring, training of teachers and construction/rehabilitation of classroom environment across the project period.
Adhere to the Do no Harm principles across the entire steps of the project within the Programme Management Cycle.
Internal and external engagements
Ensure that the program experience is represented and given recognition at stakeholder meetings, workshops, donor, networks and any other engagements.
Develop and maintain regular channels of communication with other consortium partners and key stakeholders at all levels (LGAs, States and National).
MEAL
Effectively support team members in MEAL aspects, which include assessments, baseline, and evaluation studies, putting in place a functional Activity Tracking Table.
Ensure that the projects’ quality benchmarks are followed up and implemented in project interventions.
Collecting and managing complaints and feedback in close coordination with MEAL team and Education Team.
Ensure regular monitoring of projects results, documentation of projects case studies, lessons learnt, significant changes and best practices and coordinating learning and reflection meetings/sessions.
Ensure an effective programs/ projects monitoring, and evaluation systems is in place.
Monitor programs/ projects activities to ensure quality, timeliness and adherence to both Country Office and Save the Children policies and procedures.
Human Resources Management and Development:
Working together with the Deputy Consortium Manager to identify learning needs and develop specific plans to address the learning needs.
Support implementation of Save the Children performance management system, by supporting, supervising, and reviewing performance of Education Officers.
Setting and managing staffing targets, performance, and priorities for the project team.
Coaching and mentoring the project team on the provision of technical support and implementation of quality programmes.
QUALIFICATIONS
Minimum of
a Bachelor’s degree in education or other related fields
. Experience in managing integrated programmes across different thematic areas such as education, teacher education, Teacher Professional Development (TPD), child protection, child rights or governance is an advantage.
EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS
Essential
At least 5 years of accrued working experience in program implementation with an International NGO and those applying partnership approaches is desirable.
Experience in strategic thinking and planning skills, be able to set priorities, prepare manageable plans and to evaluate progress.
Experience of working on ABEP, Teacher Professional Development and with Out of School Children (OOSC) with local partners and Local Government and State Authorities in Nigeria is desirable.
Knowledge on the use of learner’s assessment tools such as ASER is an added advantage.
Strong analytical skills and strategic planning abilities.
Ability to establish and maintain conducive collegial relations and perform effectively as a member of a team.
Ability to coach, mentor and build the capacity of teachers or volunteer teachers within a development setting is of added advantage.
Willingness to travel and work in hard-to-reach areas, occasionally under strenuous conditions.
Computer literacy and excellent documentation skills are a must.
Availability and willingness to work extra hours during times of humanitarian responses.
Highly developed cultural awareness and ability to work well in an international environment with people from diverse backgrounds and cultures.
Ability to intervene with crisis management or troubleshooting as necessary.
Highly developed interpersonal and communication skills including influencing, negotiation and coaching.
Excellent time management and planning capacity.
Fluent English language skills (written and verbal) and Local language skills (Hausa, etc.).

Job Description:
Summary:
The United States Agency for International Development (USAID) in Abuja, Nigeria is seeking eligible and qualified applicants for the Acquisition and Assistance Specialist position in the USAID OAA Office. The U.S. Mission in Nigeria supports Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Accessibility (DEIA).
Duties
The Acquisition and Assistance Specialist (Entry Level/EL) is located ln the Regional/Mission Office of Acquisition and Assistance. The function of the Office is to provide Acquisition and Assistance (A&A) support to Technical Offices and Development Objective (DO) Teams in the Mission, and in any Offices that may be supported by the Mission. The primary purpose of this position is to support the cognizant Mission Contracting/Agreement Officer, by performing a variety of A&A duties including, writing grants, cooperative agreements, contracts, and other procurement instruments, and preparing amendments/modifications to such instruments in support of the Mission.
The Specialist reviews and recommends approval or revision of requisitions in the Global Acquisition and Assistance System (GLAAS); reviews and recommends approval or revision of statements of work (SOW); drafts A&A solicitation documents; performs cost and price analysis; analyzes A&A offers or applications received; drafts A&A award instruments and modifications; analyzes budgets; recommends special A&A award requirements; writes memoranda of negotiation; and, prepares other required documentation. The Specialist maintains up-to-date A&A files and records, manages Contractor Performance Assessment Reports (CPARs), and supports award closeout. The Specialist provides guidance to supported Teams related to A&A award modifications. The Specialist is responsible for carrying out day-to-day activities under the mentorship of more senior Office employees.
Education Requirements:
A Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent of a four-year US college/university degree is required.
Experience
:
A minimum of two (2) years of progressively responsible experience in acquisition and assistance, development assistance, or a position that requires closely related skills, such as program management, law, or financial management, is required. One year of this experience must have been gained working in a position equivalent to responsibilities in this job description or an occupation that requires similar skills.
At least two (2) years of this experience must have been gained working in a position equivalent to responsibilities in this job description or an occupation that requires similar skills within an international/local organization, U.S. Government department or agencies or other international development organizations.
Note: The USAID HCTM's Substitution of Experience for Education policy flexibilities can be considered.
Skills And Abilities:
The ability to plan and administer simple A&A activities and provide A&A support for Agency programs and projects in a timely manner, is required. The ability to apply contracting and assistance regulations, procedures, and policies to acquisition and assistance programs involving few complexities, is required. Skill in solving practical problems relating to A&A is required. An ability to deal effectively with mid- to high-level representatives of the US, local, and regional business community, and with colleagues in USAID Missions and/or host governments throughout the region, is required. Skill in the use of most elements of the Microsoft Office suite is required.
Good analytical, negotiating, and time management skills, along with strong proofreading skills and attention to detail, are required. The ability to work calmly, tactfully, and effectively under pressure is essential, as well as the ability to maintain strict CONFIDENTIALITY, and meet all STANDARDS OF CONDUCT/ETHICS STANDARDS in accordance with US Jaw throughout all phases of the A&A process, is required.
Demonstrated ability to organize and manage A&A actions and filing systems effectively; ability to deal effectively with mid and high-level officials of agency/host government/private sector is required. Must have analytical skills in order to determine applicability of USAID regulations pertaining to filing and closeout of A&A actions. Must have the ability to learn federal acquisition regulation and code of federal regulation with respect to procurement rules and regulations. Ability to do research on the internet is required.

Diagnostic medical sonographers work with doctors, Nurses,and patients of all ages, from infants to the elderly.
Similar diagnostic imaging roles include magnetic resonance imaging technologists and radiation technologists, who assist with conducting and interpreting MRI scans and X-rays, respectively.
Diagnostic medical sonographers can specialize in a variety of areas. For example, vascular technologists create images of blood vessels, while obstetric and gynecologic sonographers specialize in imaging the female reproductive system.
Other specialized sonographers may focus on imaging the abdomen, musculoskeletal system, or blood vessels.
A sonographer who focuses on imaging the heart is called an echocardiographer, and they provide visualizations of patients’ heart valves and cardiac arteries.
While some employers may want specialized sonographers, many general sonographer positions will require imaging experience in several of these areas.
Diagnostic medical sonographers are often found performing ultrasound procedures at a patient’s bedside, but also may work with imaging machines in a dedicated room within the hospital or clinic.

Job Description:
A Diesel Mechanic, or Diesel Service Technician, inspects, diagnoses and repairs diesel-powered vehicles and machines, like trucks, and trailers. Their main duties include running diagnostic tests on vehicles, replacing the vehicles’ engine, transmission, steering mechanism or braking system and test driving the vehicle to determine if they properly fixed the maintenance issue.
Diesel Mechanic duties and responsibilities
Diesel Mechanics collaborate with other repair team members to ensure a vehicle is safely and efficiently operating to the driver’s needs. They often have the following duties and responsibilities:
Consulting the customer and reading work orders to evaluate the tasks required

Job Description:
Job Summary
Our client is seeking a knowledgeable and proactive IT Governance Specialist to enhance our IT governance framework and ensure robust compliance with various standards.
The ideal candidate will lead the implementation of key ISO standards, including ISO 22301 (Business Continuity Management System BCMS), ISO/IEC 27001 (Information Security Management System ISMS), and ISO/IEC 27017 (Cloud Security), as well as other relevant IT governance and fintech standards.
This role is essential for aligning our practices with the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) framework, Nigerian Data Protection Regulation (NDPR), and international best practices.
Responsibilities
Development and Implementation of IT Governance Framework:
Design, implement, and continuously enhance the IT governance framework in accordance with ISO standards (BCMS, ISMS, SMS) and regulatory requirements from CBN, NDPR, and other relevant international standards.
Establish policies, procedures, and controls that optimize IT resources, manage risks, and ensure compliance with applicable regulations.
ISO Standards Implementation:
Lead the adoption of ISO 22301 (BCMS) to ensure business continuity and effective recovery in the event of disruptions.
Oversee the implementation of ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS) to establish a framework for managing sensitive company information and ensuring information security.
Facilitate the implementation of ISO/IEC 27017 (Cloud Security) and other relevant standards to enhance security in cloud computing environments.
Compliance and Risk Management:
Conduct regular risk assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with CBN guidelines, NDPR, and other relevant regulations.
Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of controls and governance practices, ensuring they meet established standards and frameworks.
Training and Awareness Programs:
Develop and deliver comprehensive training programs to enhance employee awareness and understanding of IT governance policies, ISO standards, and compliance requirements.
Foster a culture of security and compliance throughout the organization through ongoing education and engagement initiatives.
Reporting and Documentation:
Prepare detailed reports on governance, risk management, and compliance status for review by senior management and relevant stakeholders.
Maintain thorough documentation of IT governance policies, procedures, risk assessments, and compliance activities.
Stakeholder Collaboration:
Serve as the primary point of contact between IT, compliance, legal, and operational teams to ensure alignment on governance initiatives and regulatory requirements.
Engage with external auditors, regulatory bodies, and industry groups to facilitate compliance assessments and audits.
Continuous Improvement:
Stay updated on the latest developments in IT governance, data protection regulations, and emerging technologies relevant to the fintech sector.
Recommend enhancements to existing governance frameworks, policies, and practices based on industry best practices and regulatory changes.
Policy Development and Review:
Lead the development and regular review of IT governance policies to ensure they remain effective and aligned with organizational goals and compliance requirements.
Ensure that all policies are effectively communicated to employees and stakeholders.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Business Administration, or a related field.
Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer, ISO 27017, or equivalent are highly desirable.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT governance, risk management, or compliance roles, with a strong understanding of relevant ISO standards and regulations from CBN, NDPR, and international best practices.
Proven experience in implementing and managing ISO 22301 (BCMS), ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS), and other IT governance frameworks.
Strong knowledge of risk management principles, compliance auditing, and the regulatory landscape relevant to the fintech sector.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
Working Conditions:
Primarily office-based with the possibility of remote work flexibility.
Occasional travel may be required for training, audits, or stakeholder engagements.

Job Description:
The Opportunity
In this role as the Research Engagement Officer, you will reporting to the Research Manager of Plan International's Real Choices, Real Lives project. The project, which has tracked a cohort of girls from nine countries since 2006, aims to provide deep qualitative insights into the experiences of girls growing up in diverse contexts over 18 years. With the final data collection completed in 2024, the focus now is on analyzing this comprehensive dataset to understand the evolving realities of girls' lives and embedding these findings into Plan International's broader efforts to combat gender inequality. This is a pivotal time to contribute to this unique and impactful research initiative.

Masters level qualification or equivalent experience in research methods, development studies, international studies, or a related subject.

Experience in providing project management support, including developing workplans, creating activity budgets and tracking spend against budgets, creating terms of reference for consultants and service providers, and contributing to risk management processes.

Job Description:
Job Summary
As the Head, Central Production, you will be responsible foroverseeing the entire central production facility, ensuring that all food products are prepared, packaged, and distributed efficiently.
This role involves managing production schedules, coordinating with procurement and logistics, maintaining strict food safety and hygiene standards, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to optimize production processes.
The Head of Central Production will also manage a team of production staff, ensuring that they are well-trained and motivated to meet the company’s operational goals
Key Responsibilities
Ensure Efficient and Consistent Food Production:
Oversee daily operations of the central production facility, ensuring efficient and timely production of food items.
Develop and implement production schedules to meet the demand of all outlets, balancing quality and efficiency.
Monitor production processes to ensure consistency in taste, quality, and presentation.
Quality Control:
Maintain high standards of food safety and hygiene, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and company policies.
Conduct regular quality checks and audits to ensure products meet established standards.
Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance production quality and efficiency.
Team Leadership:
Manage and mentor a team of production staff, ensuring they are well-trained and motivated.
Foster a positive work environment that encourages teamwork, accountability, and professional development.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to drive improvement and productivity.
Inventory and Supply Chain Coordination:
Collaborate with procurement and logistics teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of raw materials and ingredients.
Monitor inventory levels and manage stock to minimize waste and prevent shortages.
Optimize the supply chain process to improve cost-efficiency and reduce lead times.
Process Optimization:
Analyze production data and workflows to identify areas for improvement in efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
Implement and monitor lean manufacturing techniques and other best practices to enhance production processes.
Lead projects aimed at streamlining operations and reducing production costs.
Safety and Compliance:
Ensure all production activities comply with health and safety regulations, maintaining a safe working environment for all staff.
Develop and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) to mitigate risks and ensure consistent production outcomes.
Stay informed of industry trends and regulatory changes, updating practices as necessary.
Reporting and Analysis:
Prepare regular reports on production performance, including metrics such as output, quality, and cost efficiency.
Analyze production data to forecast demand, plan capacity, and allocate resources effectively.

Responsibilities
Management of the day-to-day activities of the Organisations
Strategic oversite to all business support functions
Plan, Coordinate, Direct and Responsible for high level leadership in area of Operations management, business process & structure, client and business development, client and stakeholders management, talent management, customer relations/engagement, finance & internal control.
Act as Advisor to Partnership, providing subject matter input into strategy formulation and implementation.
Sets and monitor performance and operational metrics for the Firm to increase organisational efficiency.
Lead, Motivate and Manage team of Lawyers.
Coach, Support and provide guidance and on-the-job trainings to Associates.
Advising clients on diverse subject matters and a broad range of Law
Providing legal advice and measures to avoid disputes to clients.
Advise clients on how to protect their interests in the event of disputes.
Drafting Legal Instruments
Corporate Governance for clients
Provide Company Secretariat Services to clients.
Spearhead and manage projects to support the clients in ensuring law compliance or dealing with legal issues encountered during business.
Overall Management of Assignment of different issues
Advising on day-to-day business affairs and activities of Organisations
Generate business opportunities for the organisation.
Analyse firms’ strategy and
Innovate business development initiatives.
Review and revise project deliverable developed by team members to maintain high standard of professional service.
Build and maintain productive working relationships with clients.
Working with Start-Ups and MSMEs on compliance and any other business Governance issues
Undertake other project and firm development works as required.
Legal Communication Skills:
Oral Communication:
Demonstrates excellent oral and spoken communication skills.
Conveys information to people at different levels and roles clearly, simply and effectively.
Presentations and Public Speaking:
Delivers presentations and public speeches within the firm and on behalf of the firm
Writing Skills:
Demonstrates excellent written communication skills.
Clearly and logically presents subject matter in a well thought out, organized, clear and succinct manner that communicates the (legal) content and opinions accurately.
Publications:
Writes or prepares well researched legal articles, conference papers, presentations or similar items for publication or presentation within and outside the organization.
Working relationship:
The Senior Legal Associate will:
Be accountable to the Principal Partner
Be directly responsible for other Junior Associates and Staff
Enforce Company Policies
Manage Company Operations
Manage Stakeholders
Qualifications
Professional qualifications i.e., LLB, BL, LLM
Enthusiasm for working with young organizations/start-ups.
Excellent organizational skills and demonstrated ability to create and implement new systems that keep the companies running smoothly, while also accounting for differing work styles and remote locations of staff.
Excellent written and oral communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Demonstrated capacity to think strategically with expertise in complex problem solving, decision making and critical thinking skills.
Ability to work with little supervision and able to meet deadlines comfortably.
Flexibility, adaptability, and willingness to take on a wide range of tasks.
Ability to handle confidential matters.
Computer skills is essential.
Ability to multitask and work under pressure
Experience in co-ordinating budgeting processes and managing budgets and monitoring and supervising administrative processes
Good oral and written communication skills.
Competencies:
Entrepreneurial Orientation:
Able to look for and seize profitable business opportunities.
Willing to take calculated risks to achieve business goals of the Firm.
Understands the Firm's competitive advantages in different areas and can leverage existing business and personal relationships and networks to develop new briefs and secure new transaction opportunities in those areas.
Can protect a brief using relationships.
Analytical Thinking:
Able to tackle business challenges and come up with solutions by using a logical, systematic, and sequential approach.
Able to effectively and logically apply the Law to resolve issues and provide solutions to legal maters.
Quickly identifies the central or underlying issues in complex situations. Uses this insight to support quick and accurate decision-making.
Able to make hard decisions in a timely manner.
Easily identifies patterns and trends and their implications.

Can structure transactions to balance multiple client interests with long term Firm profitability and sustainability goals.
Understands how to negotiate and structure transactions to influence policy, practices, and trends beyond the Firm and in the wider industry and economy.

Able to interpret complex, technical legal issues into comprehensible advice which is practical and based on a thorough understanding of the reality of the current situation.

Persuasive presenter to small and large audiences.
Self-aware and adapts communication style to influence the situation
and achieve the desired outcome.
Able to manage, resolve or diffuse difficult and/or sensitive situations
with tact and professionalism.

Learns from both successes and mistakes.
Demonstrate desire not just to learn but also the teach.
Uses engagement opportunities as teaching moments and makes self available for assisting others in professional development.
Shares knowledge through presentations, publications, and other platforms.

Consistent,
Reliable and uses a variety of ways to get things done.
Stands up for what s/he believes to be the right option.
Goes back a second or third time or however many times are needed to secure agreement or approval.

Regularly comes up with creative but practical solutions to effectively address the requirements from multiple parties in complex transactions.

We are seeking a skilled and compassionate ICU Nurse to join our Intensive Care Unit (ICU) team at Redeemers Health Village (RHV).
The ICU Nurse will be responsible for delivering specialized nursing care to critically ill patients requiring intensive monitoring, advanced interventions, and comprehensive support.
This role offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic healthcare environment, providing high-quality care to patients with complex medical and surgical conditions.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct thorough assessments of critically ill patients admitted to the ICU, including ongoing monitoring of vital signs, neurological status, and hemodynamic parameters.
Utilize advanced monitoring equipment and technology to assess patients' responses to treatment, detect changes in condition, and intervene promptly to prevent deterioration.
Perform advanced nursing interventions and procedures as needed, including airway management, mechanical ventilation, hemodynamic support, and administration of vasoactive medications.
Collaborate with the multidisciplinary healthcare team to develop and implement individualized care plans, incorporating evidence-based practices and best clinical judgment.
Administer medications and intravenous therapies to critically ill patients, ensuring accurate dosing, proper titration, and monitoring for adverse effects.
Monitor medication infusions, including sedatives, analgesics, and vasopressors, to maintain therapeutic levels and optimize patient comfort and stability.
Provide emotional support and education to patients and their families, explaining treatment options, procedures, and expected outcomes in a compassionate and culturally sensitive manner.
Foster a therapeutic and supportive environment in the ICU, advocating for patients' needs and preferences while respecting their autonomy and dignity.
Participate in quality improvement initiatives, audits, and research projects to enhance the safety, effectiveness, and efficiency of ICU nursing care, contributing insights and recommendations for practice improvement.
Qualifications and Experience

About the Role
Klasha is looking to hire Fixed Income Trader who is responsible for the buying and selling of fixed-income securities, such as bonds and other debt instruments, on behalf of clients or the firm.
This role requires a deep understanding of the fixed-income market, strong analytical skills, and the ability to make quick decisions under pressure.
Fixed Income Traders play a crucial role in ensuring that portfolios are managed effectively, risks are mitigated, and investment strategies are executed efficiently.
Key Responsibilities
Execute Trades: Execute trades in fixed-income securities to meet the firm's or client's investment objectives, ensuring best execution practices and adherence to trading limits and guidelines.
Market Monitoring: Continuously monitor market trends, economic data, and geopolitical events to identify trading opportunities and potential risks. This includes staying updated on interest rates, credit spreads, and other relevant indicators.
Relationship Management: Maintain and develop strong relationships with brokers, clients, and other market participants. This involves regular communication, understanding client needs, and providing market insights and trading recommendations.
Portfolio Management: Manage and optimize the firm's or client's fixed-income portfolios by rebalancing, adjusting strategies, and ensuring alignment with investment objectives and risk tolerance.
Financial Analysis: Analyze and interpret financial data, including bond yields, credit ratings, and economic reports, to make informed trading decisions. This includes conducting credit analysis and assessing the impact of macroeconomic trends on fixed-income securities.
Regulatory Compliance: Stay updated with regulations and compliance requirements affecting fixed-income trading. Ensure all trading activities adhere to regulatory standards and internal policies.
Reporting: Prepare detailed reports on trading activities, portfolio performance, and market conditions. Present findings to senior management, clients, and other stakeholders.
Qualifications
Educational Background: Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field is required. A Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline is preferred.
Experience: Proven experience in fixed-income trading or a related financial markets role is essential. This includes a thorough understanding of fixed-income instruments, market dynamics, and trading strategies.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and quantitative skills are crucial for analyzing market data, performing financial modeling, and making data-driven trading decisions.
Communication Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required to interact effectively with clients, brokers, and team members. This includes the ability to explain complex financial concepts clearly.
Work Environment: Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment where quick decision-making is essential. This includes managing stress and maintaining composure during volatile market conditions.
Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in trading software, financial analysis tools, and Microsoft Excel is required. Familiarity with Bloomberg, Reuters, and other financial information platforms is advantageous.
Continuous Learning: A proactive attitude towards continuous learning and professional development to stay current with the evolving security landscape.
Market Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of fixed-income securities and markets, including government and corporate bonds, municipal bonds, and structured products.
Decision-Making: Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to evaluate multiple factors and make informed choices quickly.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in executing trades, analyzing data, and preparing reports.
Risk Management: Ability to manage risk effectively by assessing market conditions, identifying potential threats, and implementing risk mitigation strategies.
Financial Modeling: Proficiency in financial modeling and quantitative analysis to support trading strategies and portfolio management.
Additional Requirements:
Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst), FRM (Financial Risk Manager), or similar are highly desirable. These certifications demonstrate a commitment to professional development and a high level of expertise in financial analysis and risk management.
Work Hours: Willingness to work irregular hours depending on market conditions and trading volumes. This may include early mornings, late evenings, and occasional weekends to align with global market hours and trading opportunities.
Continuous Learning: Commitment to continuous learning and professional development. This includes staying updated on market trends, regulatory changes, and advancements in trading technology.

Access to cutting-edge technology and resources necessary for the role
Private health insurance
Paid birthday day off
Paid parental leave
Menstrual leave
Budget for French or Chinese language classes
Learning support budget
Generous stock option plan for full-time permanent employees.

Here at Arla we strive to be responsible and open-minded to your needs and ideas. We aim to make the most out of milk to help you make the most out of life - throughout life.

A cooperative dairy company
You may not know this, but Arla Foods is a cooperative owned by 13.500 dairy farmers. The coo...read moreperative ethos means we all work together to continuously create something stronger and better, for the benefit of our farmer owners. This principle has always been at the heart of everything we do and it is why we are still here today, and going strong, over 100 years after Arla first started.

HISTORY
Way back in the 1880’s, dairy farmers in Denmark and Sweden formed small cooperatives to invest in common dairy production facilities. By doing this they made efficient use of their milk and higher quality products. The earnings they made from their milk were equally split between the dairy farmers and together they built a good future for themselves and the next generation on their farm.
Over the years, the cooperative idea proved increasingly attractive. Small farmer cooperatives merged and became stronger. They expanded from local to regional to national cooperatives. In 2000, the largest Danish dairy cooperative merged with its Swedish counterpart and Arla Foods, the first cross-border dairy cooperative, was formed.

The cooperative idea also flourished in other countries and through recent mergers cooperative owners in the UK, the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium and Luxembourg have joined Arla Foods. And we will continue to grow stronger...

About the Role
We are looking for a passionate Customer Experience Coordinator, who will manage the primary points of contact for our customers, ensuring every interaction is an outstanding experience. You will manage inquiries, resolve complaints, and proactively reach out to customers to gather feedback. Your role is crucial in maintaining customer satisfaction and loyalty, contributing to the our organization’s overall success.
You will report to the Business Analysis Specialist and manage a range of 2-6 people under the Customer Experience Team.
Responsibilities
CE Function Management
Promote inbound and outbound calls execution Goals.
Collaborate with CE Officers to develop hotline reports and continuously review and enhance CE trainings, policies, and Service Level Agreements.
Manage CP/CX survey forms, dashboards, and reports, and set weekly survey targets.

Team and Performance Management
Build the CE team's skills and coordinate their daily operations and activities.
Perform quality checks on tickets and call records to ensure satisfactory customer service.
Develop SOPs to enhance the efficiency of call center teams and create a conducive work environment.
Ensure accurate ticket categorization and prompt resolution, and conduct bi-annual performance reviews of the CE team.
CE Improvement Tasks
Develop, align, and implement the call center operational strategy.
Identify areas for improvement in Customer Experience processes and propose solutions.
Create a weekly Customer Experience Journey report and project-specific dashboards, presenting findings and progress to the Country Leadership.
Unit’s Liaison and Collaboration
Coordinate with other departments to handle call and SMS-related cases
Share the monthly Service Level Agreement (SLA) report with all team members and supporting teams.
Represent the team in any meetings with external partners
Review all call or SMS-related reports from team members and share or delegate sharing with relevant department.
Career Growth and Development
We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

2+ years proven customer support experience with a minimum of 1 year working as customer experience lead
Familiarity with CRM systems and practices
Strong phone contact handling skills and active listening
Experience interpreting and responding to customer requests.
Data analysis and data manipulation is required

Proficiecy in Hausa language.

As soon as possible

Minna, Nigeria

Health insurance, paid time off

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Nigeria

23 September 2024
